# Lambert + Associates

> > European consultancy mastering the art of smart retail for fashion and luxury brands and retailers across Paris, London, Milan, and beyond.

Lambert + Associates provides strategic retail consulting services including remote buying, brand scouting, visual merchandising, and digital training. The firm works with luxury retailers, emerging designers, and organizations across Europe, the Middle East, and North America, with offices in London and Paris.

## Key Topics

- Luxury retail consulting
- Brand scouting and curation
- Remote buying services
- Visual merchandising strategy
- Retail innovation
- Fashion retail consulting
- Digital training for designers
- Buying and merchandising
- Multi-label concept stores
- Retail strategy development
- Paris, London, Milan fashion markets
- DFS Group luxury retail
- The Style Pulse methodology
- European fashion consultancy
- Retail transformation

## Services Overview

- [Lambert + Associates | Mastering the art of smart retail](https://www.lambert.associates): European consultancy for retailers & brands in fashion and luxury
- [For retailers | Lambert + Associates | Mastering the art of smart retail](https://www.lambert.associates/for-retailers): Strategic services for retailers: sourcing, buying, digital & merchandising
- [For brands | Lambert + Associates | Mastering the art of smart retail](https://www.lambert.associates/for-brands): Strategic services for brands: digital, branding, exports & production
- [For organizations | Lambert + Associates](https://www.lambert.associates/for-organizations): Retail innovation conferences & mentorship programs for organizations

## Core Services

- [Remote Buying - Smart buys without traveling | Lambert + Associates](https://www.lambert.associates/remote-buying): Remote buying service for fashion retail without travel risks
- [Digital Training | Lambert + Associates](https://www.lambert.associates/digital-training): Digital marketing training for emerging designers in Paris, Milan, London
